title_ar: الشيخ الددو يحاضر في الحوض الشرقي ضمن برنامجه الدعوي في الشرق الموريتاني
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures in Hodh ech Chargui as Part of His Da'wah Programme in Eastern Mauritania
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو ظهر أمس الاثنين - 11 سبتمبر 2023م - بمقاطعة النعمة محاضرته الرابعة ضمن البرنامج الدعوي لفضيلته، وقد تحدث عن مسؤولية المسلم تجاه دينه ومقدساته
مبينا أن المسلم مسؤول أمام الله عن رسالة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهو ممتحن في هذه الحياة، ومطالب بالدفاع عن دينه وعرض رسوله.
مؤكدا أن فلاسفة الغرب لما عجزوا عن إفساد عقيدة المسلم وإضعاف حبه وتعلقه بنبيه صلى الله عليه وسلم أرادوه أن يعيش لغرائزه مبتعدا عن دينه وعلاقته بربه؛ لذلك استحدثوا مجموعة من النظريات الداعية إلى نبذ الأديان، والتعلق بالمادة، ومحاربة الفطرة السليمة، وإشاعة الفواحش.
وتأتي هذه المحاضرة ضمن البرنامج الدعوي الذي تنظمه جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم.
ويشمل هذا البرنامج مجموعة من المحاضرات العلمية والدعوية الداعية إلى تزكية النفس البشرية والحث على مكارم الأخلاق وضرورة انشغال الإنسان بما يضمن له حسنتي المعاد والمعاش.
ويأتي هذا البرنامج ضمن الخطة الدعوية لرئيس جمعية المستقبل فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو
وكان فضيلته قد افتتح برنامجه الدعوي بمحاضرة بمدينة اغشوركيت مساء السبت الماضي 09 سبتمبر 2023م
وقد تضمن البرنامج تعزية لفضيلة الشيخ أحمد جدو ولد أحمد باهي نائب رئيس مجلس شورى الجمعية بقرية بوخزامة التي وصل إليها الشيخ ليلة الاثنين قبل أن يلقي محاضرتين لسكان القرية كانت أولاهما عن ضرورة تزود المسلم للدار الآخرة مستشهدا بحديثه صلى الله عليه وسلم " كفى بالموت واعظا "، وحثهم في المحاضرة الثانية على المحافظة على القيم، والمنافسة في الطاعات، والاقتداء بسيد الخلق أجمعين صلى الله عليه وسلم
كما ألقى فضيلته محاضرة في مدينة تمبدغة الليلة الماضية تحدث فيها عن خلق المسلم، ومايجب أن يكون عليه في هذه الدنيا من الفطنة واليقظة وتقديم أمر الله، كما استعرض قصة أصحاب الكهف وإيمانهم الله، وتضحيتهم في سبيله تعالى.
ومن المنتظر أن يتضمن البرنامج محاضرات أخرى في كل من ولعيون والطينطان وكيفة وكرو.
body_en:
At midday yesterday, Monday 11 September 2023, in the district of Néma, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew delivered his fourth lecture within His Eminence's da'wah programme, speaking about the Muslim's responsibility towards his religion and its sanctities,
explaining that the Muslim is answerable before God for the message of Muhammad, God bless him and grant him peace; that he is under trial in this life; and that he is required to defend his religion and the honour of his Messenger.
He affirmed that when the philosophers of the West proved unable to corrupt the Muslim's creed (ʿaqīdah) and to weaken his love for his Prophet, God bless him and grant him peace, and his attachment to him, they wanted him to live for his appetites, keeping away from his religion and from his relationship with his Lord; and that they therefore devised a set of theories calling for the casting off of religions, for attachment to matter, for war on sound natural disposition (fiṭrah), and for the spreading of gross indecencies.
This lecture comes within the da'wah programme organised by the al-Mustaqbal Association for Da'wah, Culture and Education.
This programme takes in a set of scholarly and da'wah lectures calling for the purification of the human soul (tazkiyah), urging noble character, and the necessity that a person occupy himself with what secures for him the good of both the hereafter and this life.
This programme comes within the da'wah plan of the president of the al-Mustaqbal Association, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew.
His Eminence had opened his da'wah programme with a lecture in the town of Aghchorguitt on the evening of last Saturday, 9 September 2023.
The programme included a visit of condolence to His Eminence Sheikh Ahmad Jiddou Ould Ahmad Bahi, deputy chairman of the Association's consultative council, in the village of Boukhzama, which the Sheikh reached on Monday night before delivering two lectures to the people of the village. The first of them was on the necessity that the Muslim provide himself with provision for the abode of the hereafter, citing his saying, God bless him and grant him peace, "Death is sufficient as an admonisher"; and in the second lecture he urged them to preserve their values, to compete in acts of obedience, and to take as their model the master of all creation, God bless him and grant him peace.
His Eminence also delivered a lecture in the town of Timbedra last night, in which he spoke about the character of the Muslim, and what he ought to be in this world by way of shrewdness, alertness and putting God's command first; and he went over the story of the Companions of the Cave and their faith in God and their sacrifice in His path, exalted is He.
The programme is expected to include further lectures in each of Oualata, Tintane, Kiffa and Kouro.

flags.context: what the report says Western theories are directed against
flags.note: fiṭrah is listed in style guide section 13 as a glossary addition still pending, and workers are told to flag rather than assume. Rendered here as 'sound natural disposition'; 'primordial nature' is the more technical rendering used in creedal contexts. A fixed rendering is needed before this term is displayed.

flags.context: a hadith quoted in the lecture as reported
options: Death is sufficient as an admonisher
It is enough that death is a warner
flags.note: The report gives the words as a saying of the Prophet but supplies no narrator, no collection and no grading. Under style guide section 4 no grading may be added, and none has been. The wording is widely transmitted as a saying of the Companions and its prophetic attribution is contested, which the site should not resolve on the Sheikh's behalf.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk. Everything attributed to the Sheikh is the desk's summary of his lectures, not his words.

The body's own dates (a lecture on Monday 11 September, the programme opening on Saturday 9 September) are two to three weeks before the CMS stamp of 3 October; this report appears to have been filed late. The ISO date follows the CMS stamp as elsewhere in the corpus.

Mauritanian place names are given in the spellings used officially in Mauritania: Néma, Aghchorguitt, Boukhzama, Timbedra, Oualata, Tintane, Kiffa. الحوض الشرقي in the title is the region of Hodh ech Chargui.
عرض رسوله is 'the honour of his Messenger' — ʿirḍ, a person's honour and good name, not 'the presentation' of the Messenger.

حسنتي المعاد والمعاش alludes to the Qur'anic prayer for good in this world and the next (2:201); rendered as 'the good of both the hereafter and this life' without importing the verse, which the source does not quote.
